provenance: derived from the real-question research (TASK_CONSTRUCTION_DESIGN.md): archetypes mirror how real users ask product-research questions on r/BuyItForLife, r/headphones, review-request threads and shopping-advice forums; LLM instantiates phrasing only, never invents the archetype
usage: every task = one archetype x one unique angle x one tri-source cluster; instantiated by the tri-source-task-redesign workflow with adversarial verification (quota scan / tri-source elicitation / voice / dedupe)

buying-dilemma.desc: a concrete purchase decision with competing options and a budget tension
buying-dilemma.natural_deliverable: an actionable pick list with reasons

claim-check.desc: marketing claims the buyer distrusts; which are scientifically real
claim-check.natural_deliverable: per-claim verdicts grounded in the encyclopedia

community-vs-ratings.desc: store ratings look great but community folklore disagrees (or vice versa)
community-vs-ratings.natural_deliverable: reconciliation: what the reviews, the forum and the facts each support

durability-bifl.desc: wants the version that lasts; what actually survives years of use
durability-bifl.natural_deliverable: durable picks backed by long-term owner reports

value-question.desc: is the expensive tier genuinely better, where is the cutoff
value-question.natural_deliverable: price-band comparison with a cutoff recommendation

evolution-explainer.desc: wants to understand how the tech works/evolved before spending
evolution-explainer.natural_deliverable: a plain-language explainer anchored on encyclopedia facts plus what the community learned

use-case-fit.desc: a specific constraint (travel, sweat, small kitchen, big hands) changes the answer
use-case-fit.natural_deliverable: constraint-aware picks with the tradeoffs stated
